description: Create a professional conference schedule in LibreOffice Writer. You are provided with raw schedule data in '/home/ga/Documents/schedule_data.txt'. Create a NEW document and format it as follows: (1) Set page orientation to Landscape with 0.5-inch margins on all sides. (2) Insert a table with 4 columns (Time, Main Stage, Track A, Track B). (3) Transfer the data, ensuring that events marked '(ALL ATTENDEES)' (like Keynotes and Lunch) span across the three venue columns (merge cells for columns 2, 3, and 4). (4) Format the first row as a header that repeats across pages (Table Properties > Text Flow > Repeat heading). (5) Apply a 'Light Blue' background color to Keynote rows and a 'Light Gray' background to Lunch/Break rows. (6) Center all text vertically within cells. Save the result as '/home/ga/Documents/conference_schedule.docx'.
